description:
You are one of several procurement officers at a hospital network choosing a vendor for a new patient-records system. Each officer has reviewed different parts of the bids and reference checks.

The options are:
- Vendor A (Negarne Yertirri)
- Vendor B (Fengar Taltirtal)
- Vendor C (Talmirne Ketir)
- Vendor D (Rilynans Rimirans)

Exactly one option is best overall. Which vendor should be selected? Your notes are incomplete: other participants hold information you do not have.

agents.shard_text:
Vendor A (Negarne Yertirri):
  - Vendor A has a clear product roadmap
  - Vendor A allows workflow customisation
  - Vendor A has unresolved compliance findings
  - Vendor A currently serves 6 hospital clients
Vendor B (Fengar Taltirtal):
  - Vendor B has poor references from similar hospitals
  - Vendor B offers support only during business hours
  - Vendor B guarantees 99.9% uptime in its contract
  - Vendor B completed a successful pilot at a peer hospital
  - Vendor B estimates deployment will take 13 months
Vendor C (Talmirne Ketir):
  - Vendor C has reported financial difficulties
  - Vendor C completed a successful pilot at a peer hospital
  - Vendor C meets accessibility standards
  - Vendor C allows no customisation
  - Vendor C refuses to include an uptime guarantee
  - Vendor C supports standard interoperability formats
Vendor D (Rilynans Rimirans):
  - Vendor D allows workflow customisation
  - Vendor D offers 24/7 on-call support
  - Vendor D guarantees 99.9% uptime in its contract
  - Vendor D failed a recent security audit
  - Vendor D has no published product roadmap
  - Vendor D quoted a total cost of 623 thousand per year
